Resolves #21483

🌿 *The editor the learn pages run their examples in can no longer go unseen in the catalog.*

More components gets its third card, and Functional Components a function shown beside the component it makes. `examples/code/livePreview/` holds one `Neo.code.LivePreview` under a headline, one line on what to try and a theme button, the pattern of the renewed examples (#21175). The editor opens on Source with a `defineComponent` counter whose button text follows its `useConfig` state; Preview runs it, and an edit runs it again with one result. The button switches the page between neo-light and neo-dark, and the editor follows. The record lives in More components and is cross-listed in Functional (`alsoIn`), its cover comes from the `live-preview` capture recipe (neomjs/pages#139), and the engine e2e tier runs its spec.

Evidence: L3 (the example's e2e spec, run locally; the catalog unit and e2e specs; the cover recaptured from its recipe; `seo.json` compared with `getSeoJson()`; frames; two rounds of cold readers) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-4). Residual: none.

## Cold look

Readers without session context graded the unlabelled frames from 1 to 10 for how well a newcomer understands within ten seconds what the page shows and what to do; the group pages as pairs, in swapped order.

| Page | Reader 1 (released first) | Reader 2 (changed first) |
|---|---|---|
| More components, 1440 | 6 → 7 | 7 → 6 |
| Functional Components, 1440 | 6 → 7 | 6 → 5 |
| Example without its header, 1440 / 390 | 4 / 3 | 4 / 3 |

Each preferred the version shown second, so the group pages read as a tie. Reader 1 found More components' right column complete and Functional's code listing on topic; reader 2 found the Live Preview thumbnail's code too small to read and preferred the email client as Functional's lead. Both found the example without a title or a hint to try Preview, which the header answers:

| Example with its header | Reader 3 | Reader 4 |
|---|---|---|
| 1440 | 7 | 7 |
| 390 | 5 | 6 |

Reader 4 found the solid blue theme button louder than the Preview tab; it now has the renewed examples' ghost style (`d02880c6ec`, after the grading). Open: at 390 long lines clip with no cue that they scroll, out of scope, noted in a defect-note (whether the learn pages' editors wrap is a design call). The first readers also saw the Markdown VDOM card's caption over running text, a cover I retake next under #21367.
